Sam R: FYI FastRoute holding a crate of 10 H100s at SFO hub due to missing export paperwork. Impact: pool-us-west-dedicated-1 loses ~30% burst capacity.
Priya K: AWB 770-FR-44; carrier says customs wants commercial invoice + serial manifest. Can we provide digital manifest now?
Dylan M: I pulled serials from procurement sheet and sent to LogisticsBot. Carrier still insists on signed invoice.
LogisticsBot: Auto-uploaded manifest to carrier portal (manifest.pdf). Carrier response: will release to holding yard once invoice received; no ETA.
Claire H: Vendor (OrionTech) can issue a provisional temp swap of 4 units from their regional spares if we sign expedited RMA waiver. That would cover immediate compute but incurs return freight if units fail.
Sam R: Cost check? Priya?
Priya K: Rough numbers: temp rush air ~$10.5k/unit, return freight estimate $1.2k/unit. Finance OK with provisional charge pending credits.
Dylan M: Ops note: HF network flaps at colo last week; we should avoid bringing temps online before NOC validates control-plane connectivity.
Claire H: Agreed. Propose: 1) request vendor provisional AWB for 4 temps, 2) send signed invoice to FastRoute to free crate, 3) tag temps as quarantine and route non-critical traffic to them.
Sam R: I'll draft the expedited RMA waiver and route for signatures. Priya, get vendor provisional AWB and confirm incoterms.
Priya K: On it. Vendor says AWB 770-FR-TMP-001, incoterms DDP for temps, we pay return freight. ETA temps to SFO ~30h.
Dylan M: I'll open runbook: rollout/4781239999-sfo-temp-swap. Ops will coordinate with NOC for safe bring-up.
Sam R: Great. If carrier doesn't release crate today, escalate to procurement to push for carrier penalty.
Claire H: Noted. Will monitor and update once AWB confirmed or crate released. :white_check_mark:
